schema.description: Inferred (all-source, Alex 2026-11-24): the action units of the sold-only pinned manual EKMAN-FACS-2002, as open-access studies that cite it list them. Each property names its source authority and locator.

actionUnit.description: Inferred from PMC-8019968-FACS-ACTION-UNITS-2021, Table 3 "Action units of humans", the 44 action units defined in FACS (number and description). Conflict: PMC-7264164-FACS-ACTION-UNITS-2020 Table 1 names AU 10 "Upper lid raiser"; AU 11 "Nasolabial deepener"; AU 13 "Sharp lip puller"; AU 18 "Lip pucker"; AU 19 "Tongue Show"; AU 25 "Lips part"; AU 28 "Lip suck". The fuller 44-unit list is used.

schema.title: Facial Action Coding System (Ekman, Friesen and Hager 2002)
